issues: The request 'watch the shop' does not say what should be detected or what situation should trigger an alert; no reasonable default exists.
Placeholder spec assumes generic person detection inside a shop until the user clarifies.

If the intent is identifying specific people (e.g. known shoplifters) or judging intent/behaviour such as theft, that would be unsupported (identity recognition and intent inference are not possible).
clarification_questions: What specific objects or situations should the camera detect in the shop (e.g. people behind the counter, empty shelves, unattended cash register, customers at the checkout)?
Which situation should trigger an alert (e.g. a person present after closing hours, no staff at the counter, a shelf area empty)?
Where is the camera pointed (entrance, counter/till, shelves, stockroom)?
summary: Placeholder: detect people in a shop camera view (task needs clarification).

classes.name: person
classes.description: Any person visible in the shop camera frame, fully or partially.

visual_conditions: Daytime store lighting and dim after-hours lighting
Partial occlusion by shelves, displays and counters
People near and far from the camera
test_scenarios: Separate recording during busy opening hours with different customers
Separate recording during quiet hours or after closing with low lighting
Recording from a second camera angle if available
synthetic_targets: Low-light / night conditions in the shop
